name: street_dusk
comment: The color grade of Milestone 4 (docs/milestones/M4-look-bible.md, Colour): cool shadows, warm highlights, low-chroma colors (the street) tinted and slightly desaturated, the enemies' and the blood's saturated colors kept, and pure white stays white above `white_keep_luma`, so the hit flash does (a saturated color takes only `saturated_tint_share` of the tint and none of the desaturation). Every value is read by tools/gen_lut.gd; colors are sRGB 0-1, since the LUT is applied to the picture after tonemapping. The LUT is N slices of N x N pixels: slice = blue, x = red, y = green.
